messages.content: Inspect image 1 (RGB) to identify the requested object and destination. Image 2 is aligned depth for spatial context. Return only JSON. target_pixel and destination_pixel are [x,y] normalized integer coordinates 0 to 1000 (top-left 0,0, bottom-right 1000,1000). Select the visible object top center and destination interior. If uncertain use null points, skills [], reported_confidence 0. For a visible pick-and-place task skills must be exactly ["HOME","MOVE_ABOVE","APPROACH","GRASP","LIFT","MOVE_TO_REGION","PLACE","RELEASE","RETREAT","HOME"]. target_label describes the object. reported_confidence is your uncertainty estimate. Schema: {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"target_pixel": {"anyOf": [{"maxItems": 2, "minItems": 2, "prefixItems": [{"type": "integer"}, {"type": "integer"}], "type": "array"}, {"type": "null"}], "title": "Target Pixel"}, "destination_pixel": {"anyOf": [{"maxItems": 2, "minItems": 2, "prefixItems": [{"type": "integer"}, {"type": "integer"}], "type": "array"}, {"type": "null"}], "title": "Destination Pixel"}, "target_label": {"maxLength": 100, "minLength": 1, "title": "Target Label", "type": "string"}, "reported_confidence": {"maximum": 1, "minimum": 0, "title": "Reported Confidence", "type": "number"}, "skills": {"items": {"enum": ["HOME", "MOVE_ABOVE", "APPROACH", "GRASP", "LIFT", "MOVE_TO_REGION", "PLACE", "RELEASE", "RETREAT"], "type": "string"}, "maxItems": 20, "title": "Skills", "type": "array"}, "reason": {"default": "", "maxLength": 500, "title": "Reason", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["target_pixel", "destination_pixel", "target_label", "reported_confidence", "skills"], "title": "VisualDecision", "type": "object"}
